name: TinEye
summary: Reverse image search engine: give it an image and it finds where that image appears on the web.
description: Reverse image search and image recognition service. Its services site lists MatchEngine (finds duplicate and modified copies in your own image collection), the TinEye API (large-scale reverse image search for image verification, UGC moderation, copyright compliance and fraud detection), TinEye Alerts (automated image tracking with daily reports), WineEngine, MobileEngine and MulticolorEngine. The main tineye.com site renders only with JavaScript, so its search interface could not be read.
contains: reverse image search: find where an image appears on the web
products: MatchEngine, TinEye API, TinEye Alerts, WineEngine, MobileEngine, MulticolorEngine
API use cases: image verification, UGC moderation, copyright compliance, fraud detection
MatchEngine finds duplicate and modified copies within your own collection
